description:
Pre-existing at base, twice-measured. The UnresolvedWait stall diagnostic
renders a SET in HashSet iteration order, so one unmodified binary prints
a different error text run to run. Measurements: (a) fz-kdt.104 build
(2026-08-31, 50a33e49c): fixture 00421's error output produced three
different md5s across three runs of the base binary. (b) fz-kdt.106
sweep (2026-09-01, 1d44ac7cd): `fz2 interp` on any fixture that cannot
settle prints `compiler2 root N product path waited on ...
unresolved=[UnresolvedWait { ... }, ...]` in set order -- FIVE runs of
one release binary over fixtures2/00050_empty.fz produced FOUR distinct
stderr renderings; 90 of 577 fixtures show it (every fixture whose
compile stalls), which also makes stderr unusable as a byte-comparand in
base-vs-head sweeps (the 106 sweep had to hand-classify 90 'movers' as
noise).

FIX: canonical-comparand discipline at the presentation boundary -- sort
the wait list at the rendering site by a representative-stable key (the
StableSortKey / Types::display idiom AppliedStep's blocked-wait lists
already use per .agent/docs/telemetry.md). A packaging sort is legal
(feedback-sorting-is-a-barrier: final presentation). Add a stable-output
pin (00050_empty.fz is the cheapest reproducer).

ADJACENT (same sweep, separate render site): fixtures2/00424_protocol_no_impl.fz
panics with a raw thread id in the message (artifact.rs:155) -- run-varying,
but a panic, not a diagnostic; fix or split as bycatch when picked up.
title: UnresolvedWait set iteration order leaks into an error message: base binary prints 3 different md5s on 3 runs of 00421
